author: SickProdigy
description: Private live Codex allowance status and low-usage notifications through per-user ChatGPT device-code connections.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each participating Discord user's notification preferences and a private Codex authentication home containing renewable ChatGPT authorization. Credentials are isolated per user and are never shown in Discord or stored in Red Config. Disconnect and Red user-data deletion remove the user's local credentials and configuration after attempting remote logout.
install_msg: The cog automatically installs a shared Codex CLI on first load. The bot owner can run [p]codexset install to update or repair it. Members use [p]codex connect to privately link ChatGPT with an official device code and [p]codex to view live allowance.
name: Codex
short: Live Codex usage milestones and reset notifications.
